articles.headline: Gianni Infantino 'not fit to be FIFA president' without answers - FA chair
articles.description: Football Association chair Debbie Hewitt says Gianni Infantino is "not fit to be FIFA president" if he does not answer questions about his World Cup private investor plan or the Folarin Balogun case.

articles.headline: Gianni Infantino apologizes to FIFA Council, avoids key issues
articles.description: Gianni Infantino gave an apology to his toughest critics but no new details or documents on FIFA issues during FIFA council meetings Thursday.

articles.headline: FIFA set to change rules that led to Folarin Balogun World Cup red card reversal - sources
articles.description: FIFA is set to amend its rules to prevent a repeat of the controversial reversal of the World Cup suspension issued to Folarin Balogun, sources have told ESPN.

articles.headline: FIFA to propose sizable association payout bump from $10M to $25M
articles.description: FIFA will propose a $6.35 billion fund to its members for development between 2027 and 2030, including a boosted amount of $25 million for each association.

articles.headline: FIFA president Gianni Infantino received undisclosed $1.7M World Cup payment
articles.description: FIFA president Gianni Infantino appears to have breached FIFA regulations after an IRS filing revealed an undisclosed $1.72 million pay package on top of his declared salary for 2024.
